run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the maximum height pyramid from an array of box widths
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify correct pyramid height calculation
summarize_f_gold: summarize how f_gold sorts boxes and greedily builds pyramid layers with increasing width and count
